title.narrative: MangRes Phase 2: Mangrove Restoration as a Nature-Based Solution in Latin American and Caribbean Biosphere Reserves

description.narrative: MangRes Phase 2 is a three-year project implemented by UNESCO's Man and the Biosphere (MAB) Programme with financial support from the Government of Flanders of the Kingdom of Belgium. The project aims to enhance the restoration and sustainable management of mangrove ecosystems across six Latin American and Caribbean countries: Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador, Mexico, Panama, and Peru, while maintaining support for El Salvador through the Spanish Autonomous Organism for National Parks (OAPN). Building on the successes of the first phase, this second phase will focus on community-based ecological mangrove restoration, sustainable use and income-generating activities, capacity building, and communication and awareness raising. A transversal objective will be to strengthen South-South and North-South scientific cooperation, ensuring knowledge exchange between diverse stakeholders, including local communities, scientists, and policymakers. The project places particular emphasis on women and youth engagement to foster inclusive conservation practices.
